preconditions: Path registry (entry table at 0x8B5A3C, count 0x8B8E30) holds < 32 entries before 0x0053C800 inserts.
MAS file to be opened by 0x0053CBC0 must expose a 12-byte header; header literal 'CUBEMAS4.10' leads to indexing, 'CUBEMAS4.00'/'4.01' is rejected.
0x004F4270 requires a2 (vehicle .hdv/.svm path) resolvable to an openable file; the file is section-delimited with '['/']' style section markers.
0x004FA320 (VidMan init) is expected to run before 0x004FAC00 (post) on the same globals; dword_8AFE88 holds the audio-engine handle or 0.
0x004DCBA0 requires this[1] texture backing store allocated before D3DTextureCreation is attempted.
0x00543FA0 requires the scene graph linked list (this[64], next at +0x104) and mesh object list (this[66], next at +0x4C) to be built.
0x00545250 requires this[66] to be a valid list head (may be 0) and a2 to be a constructed scene actor node.
postconditions: 0x0053CBC0 returns 0 with *a1 = allocated 308-byte archive object appended to the global archive list; -1 for an incorrect MAS header; -2 when the file cannot be found.
0x0053CE40 unlinks and frees the archive object, decrementing dword_8B6AC0; the list head dword_8B8F14 is updated when the removed node is first.
0x0053C800 inserts or dedupes a path string in the registry; dword_8B8E30 is incremented only for a new entry.
0x0053C900 marks the matching registry entry with bit 0x400 (used flag) and then prunes it from the live table.
0x0053CA00 compacts the registry so marked (0x400) entries are dropped and the tail entries are zeroed.
0x004F4270 returns 0 on success and -1 on failure; on success it populates vehicle_definition (this) fields and vehicle_setup (a3) fields, including byte flags at a3+0x19A4/0x19A5.
0x004FA320 returns 1 when audio/scene initialization fails (after cleanup) and 0 on success; it registers a callback via sub_546230(sub_4F9480, 1090519040).
0x004FAC00 resets the frame-rate counter (dword_8AFCA8), tears down the audio engine handle dword_8AFE88, and prunes the scene path.
0x00543FA0 returns 0 on success and -1 on allocation failure, having rebuilt vertex buffers and four 528-byte mesh element arrays.
0x00545150 frees both 3D sound-source children and the node, clears the manager pointer array slot, unlinks and frees the object; returns 0.
0x00545250 appends a2 to the tail of the this[66] node list and sets a2 flags (+0x3C) bit 8 and +0x4C to 0.
side_effects: 0x004D7AA0 (DebugLogWrite): varargs helper; forwards format string a2 and va_list to the writer bound at log_handle+0x4 and re-locks through LockCallUnlockWrapper.

0x004D8AB0: resolves a content path from dword_5EC408 (or fallback byte_5EA438) plus an offset suffix, opens a MAS container via 0x0053CBC0, then opens four named streams (globals 0x8AD388/0x8AD38C/0x8AD390/0x8AD394) via sub_53CFE0 and writes this[57]/this[58] into each stream at +0x5C/+0x60; closes the container.

0x004DC450: filename normalization/compare helper; strips trailing backslashes from byte_5EA438, registers the directory, compares the basename of a3 with sub_546AA0, optionally strips the extension, registers the base name and flags it via 0x0053C900.

0x004DCBA0: texture loader entry; cleans any prior state (0x004DCD10), allocates a 96-byte texture backing store (this[1], +0x44 bit 1 set), attempts D3DTextureCreation(a3,0,2052); on failure stores a7/a8/a2 into this[5]/this[6]/this[7] and computes a position; frees opened MAS container handle v15.
0x004DD4D0: frees this[5] through FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-null.

0x004DD550: bounding-box computation; seeds a2 to +FLT_MAX and a3 to -FLT_MAX, walks the scene graph children (per-child +0x14 flags and +0xF4 float decide the level), then accumulates packed vertex array min/max into a2/a3.

0x004DDAD0: pit-crew texture path builder; reads team dir (a1+0x0), team/other names at a1+0x3CC/0x3D8 and a string list at a1+0x3D4, iterates nine crew parts (carbody/driver/arms/wing/helmet/pitbody/pithelmet/lollipop/refueler), builds '<dir>\<part>.<ext>' candidate names, calls TextureAdjuster, and frees all temporary allocations.

0x004F4270: .hdv/.svm vehicle file parser; opens a2 via sub_534B00, skips a 'Setting/Notes/Downforce/Balance/Ride/Gearing/Custom/Symmetric' preamble, then parses sections [General],[FrontWing],[LeftFender],[RightFender],[RearWing],[BodyAero],[Diffuser],[Suspension],[Controls],[Engine],[Driveline],[FrontLeft],[FrontRight],[RearLeft],[RearRight],[Basic], writing parsed scalars/vectors into vehicle_definition (this) and derived setup values into vehicle_setup (a3); loads damage file, engine file and gear file via FileFinder; logs illegal .SVM and unknown tire compound messages through 0x004D7AA0.

0x004F8D70: F1CUI font manager init; writes state fields +0x0..+0x2C (state=2, child object allocated at +0x18), registers the game root path via 0x0053C800, opens the 'aFontMas' MAS container and loads a framerate bitmap font; returns 0.

0x004FA320: video manager init; clears byte_8AFE70, derives mode flags from dword_7CFB90 via sub_54A1C0, resolves the scene path from dword_8AC48C/dword_8AC490 and registers it, formats the combined content path, registers the callback sub_4F9480 through sub_546230, and initializes the audio engine handle dword_8AFE88 from dword_7CE5D0.
0x004FAC00: video manager post/teardown; resets frame-rate counter dword_8AFCA8, releases audio engine handle dword_8AFE88, recomputes and prunes the scene path from dword_8AC48C/dword_8AC490.

0x004FC550: cloud texture loader; opens the '<root>\common\logomap.mas' container, optionally selects a random cloud scene via CloudSceneObjectRandomSelector, then loads cloud texture names into this+0x50 and this+0x84 through sub_4FC400.
0x0053C590: copies a2 into the global relocation buffer byte_8B6AC8 (used by 0x0053CBC0 error paths and 0x0053C5B0).
0x0053C5B0: copies the global relocation buffer byte_8B6AC8 back into a2.
0x0053C6B0: copies a 132-byte path registry entry (dword head + 128-byte string) from a2 into this; when a2 is null it zeroes the head and byte at this+0x4.
0x0053C800: registers a path string in the global registry; dedupes by strcmp, and for a new entry shifts existing entries down 132 bytes via 0x0053C6B0 and inserts the copy at the head.
0x0053C900: searches the registry for a2 and, when found, sets the 0x400 used-bit on the matching entry, then runs the prune via 0x0053CA00.
0x0053CA00: compacts the registry by copying non-0x400 entries into a temp table and writing them back, zeroing the freed tail; updates dword_8B8E30.

0x0053CBC0: MAS archive open; validates header, allocates a 308-byte archive object, opens/indexes the container (sub_55FBE0/sub_55FC40), links the object into the global list at dword_8B8F14, increments dword_8B6AC0 and stores the object at *a1.
0x0053CE10: archive open wrapper that sets archive flag +0x114 bit 3 (error handler attached) after a successful 0x0053CBC0.
0x0053CE40: archive close; unlinks the archive object from the global list using +0x12C (prev) / +0x130 (next), runs its destructor and frees it, and decrements dword_8B6AC0.

0x00543FA0: render mesh/vertex-buffer builder; frees the previous vertex-buffer allocation (this[0x150], count this[0x14C]), allocates a new vertex buffer of 24*this[0x64]+4 bytes, walks the scene list building four 528-byte element arrays sized from this[0x44..0x50] and allocated into this[0x1B8..0x1D0] with counts at this[0x1B4..0x1CC], classifies nodes by flag bits, fills per-node texture entry lists, and returns -1 on allocation failure.

0x005450E0: mesh resource factory; allocates a 572-byte object (sub_54A600 ctor), stores a4 at +0x3C, copies the name from a2 (length capped by a3); on name-copy failure destroys and frees it returning -1, else stores the object at *a1 and returns 0.

0x00545150: 3D sound-source destructor; destroys children at a2+0x44 and a2+0x4C, removes the scene node at a2+0x230, clears the manager slot that pointed at a2 (scanning a this[0x150] array of this[0x14C] entries at +0x10 each), unlinks the object, destroys and frees it.
0x00545250: scene actor-node append; sets a2+0x3C bit 8 and a2+0x4C to 0, accumulates the node, then appends a2 to the tail of the this[0x108] list using +0x4C (next) / +0x48 (prev).

0x004DDAD0: the string list at pit_crew_obj+0x3D4 is walked as a linked list with next at +0x10; the node type and the full meaning of the three candidate-name sources (team, driver, track) are unverified.

tests_required: Open a known-good 'CUBEMAS4.10' MAS archive via 0x0053CBC0 and assert *out != 0, return 0, and dword_8B6AC0 increments.
Attempt 0x0053CBC0 on a non-MAS file and assert return -2 and relocation buffer byte_8B6AC8 holds the error text.
Registry round-trip: register two distinct paths via 0x0053C800, mark one via 0x0053C900, run 0x0053CA00, assert the marked entry is gone and dword_8B8E30 reflects the compaction.
Parse a fixture .hdv file through 0x004F4270 and assert return 0 with known General/Suspension/Engine values landing at the enumerated vehicle_definition offsets.
Bounding box: feed a scene graph with known vertex data to 0x004DD550 and assert a2/a3 match the true min/max.
Video manager: run 0x004FA320 then 0x004FAC00 and assert dword_8AFE88 is non-null after init and null after post.
